items.title: Greg Thomas interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 2014
items.q: I’ve had my own interactions with Jon Hendricks

ctx.x: I just read it, and since I visited here before, I was here in 2010 for my 25th class reunion I remember seeing that. And Jon Hendricks says in his Hamilton College Jazz Archive interview, “When someone asks me about race I say ‘when does it start?’” Jon Hendricks, the master of vocalese. I’ve had my own interactions with Jon Hendricks and I’ve actually written on his vocalese work which, I think he’s the total master of vocalese an example of a work like “Joy Spring.” His vocalese rendition of Clifford Brown’s…

Well getting back to when you produce concerts and so forth. Are you conscious of the people that you book in a whole season or for a particular event? Because we both sort of agree that there’s no such thing as race, but I can’t say this question without it. Are you conscious, like gee I have booked almost all white players this season, or I have booked almost all black players this season. You know when I get the musicians for this Fallcoming jazz concert, that’s been going on for 23 years and there’s been many…
